# KomikaID

KomikaID provides a public, read-only Indonesian comics API.

Base URL: https://komikaid.pages.dev/api
API index: https://komikaid.pages.dev/api
OpenAPI 3.1: https://komikaid.pages.dev/api/openapi.json
Full AI usage guide: https://komikaid.pages.dev/llms-full.txt

## Quick usage

- Browse: GET https://komikaid.pages.dev/api/comics?page=1&pageSize=24&sort=latest
- Search: GET https://komikaid.pages.dev/api/comics/search?q=solo&page=1&pageSize=24
- Details: GET https://komikaid.pages.dev/api/comics/{mangaId}
- Chapters: GET https://komikaid.pages.dev/api/comics/{mangaId}/chapters?page=1&pageSize=50
- Reader pages: GET https://komikaid.pages.dev/api/chapters/{chapterId}

Public GET requests require no API key. Use the IDs returned by earlier responses.
Respect HTTP status codes, pagination metadata, cache headers, and rate limits.
